title: Whispering Earring
description: Gain 1 energy at the start of each turn. [red]Vakuu plays your first turn for you.[/red]
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Increases maximum energy by 1. On the first turn of combat, Vakuu automatically plays up to 13 cards from your hand. If all 13 cards are played, a warning message displays; otherwise, an approval message displays.
